filament_notes: SUNLU Easy PA datasheet: nozzle 250-280C, bed 30-50C with glue on PEI, retraction 0.8-1.2mm @ 30-40mm/s, fan off, dry 4-6h @ 80-110C. U1 owner decisions (not moisture-related): chamber 45C (PA only needs a closed chamber; 60 caused stringing and long heat-up), bed 50/50 (the bed cannot hold below chamber + 4C). WET-SPOOL variant (2026-10-22): the 2026-10-16 tuning, kept as workarounds for a spool with more moisture than ideal. Nozzle 265/270 -> 255/260 and retraction 1.0 -> 1.2mm (hair-fine stringing), part fan 20-50% with 'Keep fan always on' and fan cooling layer time 20s, overhang/bridge fan 30 -> 80% (bow sag/flex). Use the dry 'PA Sunlu Easy (ai)' once the spool is properly dry. See DECISION-LOG.md 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-22.
name: PA Sunlu Easy Wet (ai)
